title: Hard White Flour Tortillas
note: Hard white gives you the strength of red wheat without the tannic edge, which is exactly what you want in something this plain.

ingredients.item: hard white wheat berries, milled fine

steps: Mix flour and salt. Rub in the fat until it looks like damp sand.
Add hot water, stir, then knead 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and rest 45 minutes. Skipping this makes them impossible to roll thin.
Divide into 12 balls, cover, rest another 15 minutes.
Roll each as thin as you can on a bare counter — flour makes them tough.
Cook on a dry skillet over medium-high, 45 seconds a side, until puffed with brown freckles.
Stack in a towel as you go. The steam is what keeps them pliable.
milling: Whole-grain tortillas will never be as stretchy as white-flour ones. Rolling thinner matters more than kneading longer.
substitute: All-purpose flour, same weight, and drop the water to 230 g.
